page_title: EVE 3-0 NEW | Everton v Newcastle 07/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) and blew his whistle.
90+9' Tim Robinson sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Everton players aren’t happy.

90+6' 3 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Beto (Everton) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90+5' Everton string together a series of short passes.
90+2' Referee Tim Robinson halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Sean Dyche, then shows him a yellow.
90+2' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Lewis Miley is replaced by Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd).
90' Substitution. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jamaal Lascelles.
89' Ashley Young (Everton) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
88' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
87' Beto (Everton) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
86' 2 - 0 Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
86' Martin Dubravka comes off his line to intercept the corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton).

85' Jack Harrison (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
85' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin did his best and is replaced by Beto (Everton).
83' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is punished with the yellow card.
82' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar.
81' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
80' Poor challenge! Nathan Patterson (Everton) is penalised for tripping and Tim Robinson blows his whistle.
79' 1 - 0 GOAL! Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
78' Jordan Pickford (Everton) is able to continue to play.
76' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Pickford (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
75' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dwight McNeil (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
74' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
74' The game is interrupted as Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) is flagged offside.
73' The attendance is 38198.
73' Ashley Young (Everton) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
72' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Idrissa Gueye (Everton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
71' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
70' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
70' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

69' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
69' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
69' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
68' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
67' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
67' A cross from Dwight McNeil (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
67' Seamus Coleman is being substituted because of an injury. Sean Dyche sends Nathan Patterson (Everton) on the pitch.
65' Seamus Coleman (Everton) picks up an injury.
65' Alexander Isak finds Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
63' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
63' Dwight McNeil (Everton) will take a corner kick.

63' Jack Harrison (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
60' Dwight McNeil (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Alexander Isak loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd).
59' A short pass finds Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
57' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes a short free kick.
56' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is penalised for holding. Tim Robinson signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Newcastle.
55' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
51' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
50' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
50' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
50' The corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is hurriedly cleared. Everton will take a corner kick.

49' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
48' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.

47' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dwight McNeil (Everton).
47' A lofted cross from Seamus Coleman (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

45+3' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+3' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Everton have a free kick.

45+1' Looks like Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ashley Young (Everton) trips an opposition player and Tim Robinson signals a foul.

44' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
41' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Everton will take a free kick near the side line.
40' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
39' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
38' Jack Harrison (Everton) brings his opponent down. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Kieran Trippier sends a terrific cross into the box. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the left post.
35' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
34' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tim Robinson signals.
34' Dwight McNeil (Everton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
33' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
32' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
31' Jack Harrison provides the assist in the box, but Dwight McNeil (Everton) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
29' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
29' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
29' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
28' An attempted cross from Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
27' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside!
24' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
22' The total number of attempts is 11:2.

20' Martin Dubravka was forced into action to thwart Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
19' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Martin Dubravka is prepared and dives to thwart him.
18' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) anticipates the cross from Jack Harrison, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
18' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jordan Pickford is alert and denies him.

17' Alexander Isak almost found himself in a promising position after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
16' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

14' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the right post but is denied by Jordan Pickford, who pulls off a glorious save!
12' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) jumps into a tackle and Tim Robinson signals a foul. Newcastle have a free kick from a promising distance.
12' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Ashley Young (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
8' James Tarkowski (Everton) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
8' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Ashley Young (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
6' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul after Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) hacks down one of his opponents.
4' Ashley Young (Everton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
4' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

3' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tim Robinson with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will supervise the game today.
